raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

After #41818, the deprecated `--dp-size N --enable-dp-attention` spelling resolves to `dp_size=1` and `attn_dp_size=N`. In-process integrations that read `ServerArgs.dp_size` therefore register only one scheduler rank, even though SGLang serves N ranks.

This exposes the configured scheduler rank count as `ServerArgs.num_dp_ranks` and points users of the deprecated flag to that accessor.

Fixes #42560.

## Modifications

- Add `ServerArgs.num_dp_ranks`, computed from the resolved replica and attention-DP widths.
- Include the accessor in the deprecated flag's migration warning for in-process integrations.
- Extend the registered regression tests for the legacy spelling, the explicit attention-DP flag, and ordinary data parallelism.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable. This change does not affect model outputs.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. This change does not modify an inference execution path.

## Validation

- `pre-commit run --files python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/argparse_actions.py python/sglang/srt/server_args.py test/registered/unit/server_args/test_attn_dp_size.py` passed, including Ruff, formatting, spelling, and registered-test validation.
- `python -m py_compile python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/argparse_actions.py python/sglang/srt/server_args.py test/registered/unit/server_args/test_attn_dp_size.py` passed.
- The focused unit test could not be collected locally because this environment lacks SGLang runtime dependencies (`orjson` was the first missing dependency after adding the pinned PyTorch and NumPy packages). The test remains registered for the `base-a-test-cpu` suite.
- Hosted CI was not run. This repository requires the `run-ci` label, which I cannot apply. Could an authorized maintainer trigger the registered CPU test?

## Checklist

- [x] Format code according to the pre-commit guidance.
- [x] Add focused registered unit tests for the behavior.
- [x] Document the accessor in its API docstring and deprecation warning.
- [x] Accuracy and speed tests are not applicable to this change.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

nodes.body: @ch-wan CI is gated on the run-ci label, so no test job has started. Could you add it and review the rank-count accessor?

This PR alone does not resolve the Dynamo routing failure in [#42560](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/42560). We tested its diff (6743695e) on the affected GB300 deployment against an unpatched control, using the same base image, Dynamo version and workload configuration. The patched run emitted the new `num_dp_ranks` migration guidance, confirming the change was active, but both runs still routed only to `dp_rank=0`. Both hit the 1800-second warmup drain timeout and ended in ProfileAborted: 752/990 requests completed unpatched versus 756/990 patched.
The tested Dynamo consumer still reads `dp_size` and `enable_dp_attention`; exposing `num_dp_ranks` requires a corresponding consumer update. We separately validated the now-merged [ai-dynamo/dynamo#16005](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/dynamo/pull/16005), which restores routing across all attention-DP ranks and lets this workload pass.

_Drafted with assistance from Codex (GPT-6)._
